---
title: "Compare Deliveries"
subtitle: "Skill 2 — Single-seller vs. multi-seller delivery comparison"
---

<div class="question-card">
<div class="card-title">Business Question</div>
Do multi-seller orders take longer to deliver than single-seller orders?
</div>

```{r compare-setup, echo=FALSE}
source("R/website_helpers.R")
silent_run({
  source("R/compare_deliveries.R")
  res <- run_compare_deliveries("data/processed/order_level_analysis.rds")
})
```

```{r compare-kpis, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(kpi_row(c(
  kpi_card("box", "Single-Seller Median", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", res$median_single), " days"), paste0(format(res$n_single, big.mark = ","), " orders"), "blue"),
  kpi_card("boxes", "Multi-Seller Median", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", res$median_multi), " days"), paste0(format(res$n_multi, big.mark = ","), " orders"), "green"),
  kpi_card("arrow-down-up", "Observed Median Difference", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", res$median_difference), " days"), "Multi minus single", "orange"),
  kpi_card("calculator", "Hodges-Lehmann Shift", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", res$estimated_difference), " days"), "95% CI location estimate", "navy")
)))
```

<div class="two-col-grid">

<div class="dash-panel chart-panel">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-bar-chart-steps"></i></span> Delivery Time Comparison</div>
<div class="panel-body">![Delivery comparison boxplot](images/delivery_comparison_boxplot.png)</div>
</div>

<div class="dash-panel">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-table"></i></span> Group Summary</div>
<div class="panel-body">

```{r compare-group-table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Group = res$group_summary$group,
    N = format(res$group_summary$sample_size, big.mark = ","),
    Median = round(res$group_summary$median_days, 2),
    Mean = round(res$group_summary$mean_days, 2),
    SD = round(res$group_summary$sd_days, 2),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  col.names = c("Group", "N", "Median Days", "Mean Days", "SD"),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="dash-panel">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-clipboard-data"></i></span> Statistical Results</div>
<div class="panel-body">

| Result | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Selected test | `r res$test_name` |
| Observed median difference (multi − single) | **`r sprintf("%.2f", res$median_difference)`** days |
| Hodges–Lehmann location shift (multi − single) | **`r sprintf("%.2f", res$estimated_difference)`** days |
| 95% confidence interval | [`r sprintf("%.2f", res$conf_int[1])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", res$conf_int[2])`] days |
| p-value | `r format(res$p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)` |
| Faster observed group | Multi-seller orders had the lower median delivery time. |

</div>
</div>

<div class="insight-card">
<div class="card-title">Practical Interpretation</div>

- **Observed median difference:** approximately **`r sprintf("%.2f", res$median_difference)`** days (multi minus single).
- **Hodges–Lehmann estimated location shift:** **`r sprintf("%.2f", res$estimated_difference)`** days, 95% CI [`r sprintf("%.2f", res$conf_int[1])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", res$conf_int[2])`].
- **`r res$practical_note`**
- **`r res$cannot_conclude`**

</div>

<div class="warning-card">
<div class="card-title">Limitation</div>
This is observational order-level data. Seller count may correlate with basket size, distance, or category mix rather than causing delivery speed directly.
</div>

<details class="dash-details">
<summary>Exclusions and test selection details</summary>
<div class="details-body">

`r res$selection_reason`

```{r compare-exclusions, echo=FALSE}
excl <- data.frame(
  Reason = names(res$excluded),
  Excluded_Orders = as.integer(unlist(res$excluded)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(excl, align = c("l", "r"), row.names = FALSE)
```

</div>
